name: Frase
summary: AI-powered SEO content writing and optimization. Research, outline, write, and optimize articles that rank — all in one place.
best_for: content teams and SEOs who want to speed up research, briefs and SERP-driven optimization in one workflow
skip_if: you publish only occasionally — the monthly quota and subscription outweigh the time saved for a handful of articles
honest_knock: The article quotas pinch if you publish at volume (overage docs bill each), and it's a research-and-optimization tool, not a magic ranking button — it speeds up briefs, it doesn't replace the writing or the backlinks.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-03 against Frase's own machine-readable pricing file frase.io/pricing.md and the pricing page; every plan price below was unchanged from our 17 August and 14 September readings) The headline figure is the yearly rate; paying month to month costs about 25% more, and both are shown on the page. Starter $39/mo billed yearly against $49/mo monthly: 1 seat, 1 site, 10 articles and 50 audit pages a month, Content Guard watching 10 pages. Professional $103/mo yearly against $129/mo monthly: 3 seats, 5 sites, 40 articles and 250 audit pages, extra seats $29/mo. Scale $239/mo yearly against $299/mo monthly: 5 seats, up to 10 domains, 100 articles and 1,000 audit pages, Content Guard watching 300 pages, extra seats $29/mo. The trial is 7 days with no credit card. FraseCMS hosting is included free up to 100,000 page views a month; Basic at $19/mo on top of a paid plan raises that to 250,000, drops the Frase badge and lets the blog sit on your own domain or a subdirectory, and Pro is $99/mo at a million page views, with $1.00 and $0.50 per extra 1,000 page views and a spend cap set at the base price by default. On Starter, Frase stops at the limit rather than billing you extra; on Professional and Scale you can switch on pay-as-you-go capacity, so there the sticker price is a floor rather than a ceiling: Professional adds $5 per extra article, $0.50 per audit page and $0.25 per AI prompt, Scale $4, $0.40 and $0.20. API, MCP and CLI requests are capped at 5,000, 20,000 and 50,000 a month on the three self-serve plans.
